key_provisions_or_claims: Personal care robot safety standards require consideration of children but give no specific methods.
Maps JIS B 8445, B 8446, B 9700, Z 8050, Z 8071 and the ST toy safety standard to identify unclear items.
Defines children as under 14 in JIS but notes development does not stop at 14.
Proposes experimental evaluation of child contact using a dummy robot with cushioning materials, measuring impact force and impulse.
Speed normalization of collisions examined for cushioning materials.
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper from Nagaoka University of Technology on safety design of personal care robots with respect to children. It maps Japanese JIS safety standards to find gaps in child-safety guidance and proposes dummy-robot impact experiments with cushioning materials to evaluate safety in child contact.
annotation.title_clean: Safety Design of Personal Care Robots Based on Safety Standard Considering Characteristics of Children
